positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Used Agile Methodology to develop web and desktop application for sports broadcasting and coaching tools.

ASP.NET, MVC, C#, WPF, REST API, SQL, Entity Framework, WCF, SignalR, JavaScript, Telerik Kendo UI, CSS, Visual Studio, Internet Information Services, Jira

NFL Next Gen Stats - Documented and developed RESTful web api for player location, speed, and route tracking for on-air display. Debuted Pro-Bowl 2014 and executed at every game since.

OASIS - RESTful API for monitoring college football player biometrics, helmet collisions, and tracking locations for safety and coaching tools. Provided API support for third party IPhone and desktop developers for use by coaching and medical staff.

Self-Hosted RESTful API for driving sports broadcast rendering application from external applications. Executed at PGA Tour, US Open (Golf), World Figure Skating Championships, Us Open (Tennis), French Open (Tennis), and several events during the 2016 Summer Olympics.

DMX (Data Matrix Switchboard) - Developed generic application framework for hosting sports data parsers, repositories, and query handlers. Hosted components interact through WCF.

Helped introduce agile process to our team. Started user story creation, story point estimation, planning poker. Functioned as scrum master.

Created unit testing and logging process guidelines for our development team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Bluegrass Station Army Depot - Lexington, Kentucky
positions.description:
Used Agile Methodology, developed web applications for military sustainment logistics.

Developed digital signature solutions for automated signatures of documents and data using Smart Card certificates.

Managed creation of release packages for server administrators to deploy to our production environment.
Conducted peer review.

Administered all databases and servers in our test environment.

Test Knowledge - Unit Test, Integration Test, User Acceptance Test

Secret Level Department of Defense Security Clearance

ASP.NET, Visual Basic, SQL, Javascript, DevExpress, CSS, Visual Studio, Internet Information Services, Target Process, Motorola Barcode Scanners

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Knowledge of military aircraft control systems and power supply systems.

Software Development Life Cycle (Waterfall Method) with emphasis on interpreting design and requirements documents.

Code reviewed C++ and PowerPC Assembly language code and Auto-Generated C++ code, derived from VDECS (GPU) diagrams.

Module Testing - VectorCAST for design and automation of test cases and reports DO-178B levels A and C code coverage and analysis. Testing Auto-Generated C++ code from MATLAB/SIMULINK diagrams. Testing developer-written C++ and Auto-Generated C++ code derived from VDECS (GPU) diagrams.

Configuration Management - SVN for version tracking and backup. DOORS for tracking requirements. Synergy for submitting module test results to client.

Leadership - Developed tutorial document for training new Software Test Engineers. Led a remote work-site in Kentucky for a Florida-based project, including training and tasking nine intern level Software Test Engineers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Bluegrass Station Army Depot - Lexington, Kentucky
positions.description:
DoD Aircraft Cockpit Trainers: 
   - Developed software for full-sized cockpit trainers using Visual Studio, C++ .NET, and MFC
    - Implemented hardware safety systems to respond to temperature, humidity, and smoke levels
    - Created data structures to implement MIL-1553 messages
    - Presented Software Design Description to the customers
    - Debugged errors, and organized bugs using Bugzilla
    - SVN for source control to track software versions

Military Sustainment Logistics Portal:
  - Performed regression testing, following Government Acceptance Testing (GAT) guidelines to
      ensure that updates to part of the site did not interfere with other applications in the system
  - Reported and assigned bugs using BugZilla

Installation of SVN server – Installed Apache server, SVN server, and all dependencies in a  Linux environment.

Secret Level Department of Defense Security Clearance

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Created CellView project for visualizing human cell structures in 3d.
- Blender modeller and game engine
- Wrote XML parser for saving and loading 3d cell environments
- Python scripting in Blender for 3D object transformations and saving/loading files
- Demonstrated the program to other researchers at Centre’s collaborative research talks

honors.title: Belcan - Wings of Success
honors.description: Anthony’s level of work on the Apache FMCO Unit Test Program is commendable.  His work requires little review and is consistently excellent.  He has also demonstrated the type of communication that is needed to make a multiple work site project work.

honors.title: Belcan - Wings of Success
honors.description: We have identified a need to capture the knowledge base and experiences our test engineers have with conducting VectorCAST module tests based on Simulink requirements. Anthony has worked together with other team members to produce a collection of training materials. The materials capture the best practices & lessons learned in testing Simulink constructs. The team produced a step-by-step tutorial to instruct engineers in the construction of Simulink/VectorCAST module tests. This material will greatly accelerate the learning curve for new test engineers as they come on board to perform module tests in our specialized environment.
